## Purpose

Explain the problem and why the change is needed. Link the relevant Issue.

## Changes

Describe the resulting behavior and affected files. Note input/output changes and any scientific decision that needs review. Use “not applicable” for documentation-only work.

## Validation

List the checks actually run and their results. For scientific work, include the analysis ID, configuration/reference identity and relevant gate evidence. State any checks not run.

## Limits and follow-up

Record unresolved concerns, dependencies and the scope of the evidence.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change follows the scientific contracts and repository instructions.
- [ ] No raw reads, large references/indexes, caches or credentials are included.
- [ ] New or changed links, commands and version identifiers were checked.
- [ ] Scientific decisions and provenance were updated where applicable.
- [ ] Passing repository CI is not presented as biological validation.
